paragraphs.source_en: Katsuie himself had charged after the enemy three times and retreated to the keep three times. It was less to slay the enemy than to expend every last ounce of strength and find the proper moment for his own death.

units.source_en: Katsuie himself had charged after the enemy three times and retreated to the keep three times.
units.source_zh: 胜家自己也是三次追杀敌人，三次退回天守阁。

units.source_en: It was less to slay the enemy than to expend every last ounce of strength and find the proper moment for his own death.

ja.t: つためというより、むしろ

units.source_zh: 与其说是为了杀敌，毋宁说是为了用尽所有力气，为自己寻得合适的死期。

paragraphs.source_zh: 胜家自己也是三次追杀敌人，三次退回天守阁。与其说是为了杀敌，毋宁说是为了用尽所有力气，为自己寻得合适的死期。

paragraphs.source_en: At some point the sun had begun to sink in the west; it must already have been the Hour of the Monkey. Nakamura Bunkasai, his head drenched in sweat, returned to the keep and came to Katsuie's side. “My lord, the Hour of the Monkey has come.”

units.source_en: At some point the sun had begun to sink in the west; it must already have been the Hour of the Monkey.
units.source_zh: 不知何时，太阳已经西斜了，恐已是申时。

units.source_en: Nakamura Bunkasai, his head drenched in sweat, returned to the keep and came to Katsuie's side.
units.source_zh: 中村文荷斋满头大汗地回到天守阁，来到胜家的身边。

units.source_en: “My lord, the Hour of the Monkey has come.”
units.source_zh: “主公，已到了申时。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 不知何时，太阳已经西斜了，恐已是申时。中村文荷斋满头大汗地回到天守阁，来到胜家的身边。“主公，已到了申时。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Yes, I know.” Katsuie had already removed his armor and was taking away the folding screens beside Oichi's body. “Bunkasai, go below and inspect everything. You may set the fire.”

units.source_en: “Yes, I know.”
units.source_zh: “嗯，知道了。”

units.source_en: Katsuie had already removed his armor and was taking away the folding screens beside Oichi's body.
units.source_zh: 胜家已经脱去盔甲，正在撤去阿市躯体旁边的屏风。

units.source_en: “Bunkasai, go below and inspect everything. You may set the fire.”
units.source_zh: “文荷斋，你到下面检查一下，可以点火了。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “嗯，知道了。”胜家已经脱去盔甲，正在撤去阿市躯体旁边的屏风。“文荷斋，你到下面检查一下，可以点火了。”

paragraphs.source_en: “At once.” Bunkasai answered and once more hurried downstairs. Beads of sweat as large as beans rolled from Katsuie's brow. Silently, he piled the bodies of the ladies-in-waiting behind Oichi, then cradled her pale face, which bore no trace of suffering.

units.source_en: “At once.”
units.source_zh: “遵命。”

units.source_en: Bunkasai answered and once more hurried downstairs.
units.source_zh: 文荷斋应一声，再次向楼下奔去。

units.source_en: Beads of sweat as large as beans rolled from Katsuie's brow. Silently, he piled the bodies of the ladies-in-waiting behind Oichi, then cradled her pale face, which bore no trace of suffering.
units.source_zh: 胜家的额头上滴下豆大的汗珠，默默地把侍女们的尸体堆积到阿市后面，然后扶住阿市那毫无痛苦的苍白脸庞。

paragraphs.source_zh: “遵命。”文荷斋应一声，再次向楼下奔去。胜家的额头上滴下豆大的汗珠，默默地把侍女们的尸体堆积到阿市后面，然后扶住阿市那毫无痛苦的苍白脸庞。

paragraphs.source_en: “Oichi, watch me well!” Katsuie suddenly muttered to himself, drawing great, ragged breaths.

units.source_en: “Oichi, watch me well!”
units.source_zh: “阿市，你好好看着！”

units.source_en: Katsuie suddenly muttered to himself, drawing great, ragged breaths.
units.source_zh: 胜家突然自言自语，大口大口地喘着气。

paragraphs.source_zh: “阿市，你好好看着！”胜家突然自言自语，大口大口地喘着气。

paragraphs.source_en: By then, apart from Katsuie, only some thirty bodies remained in the keep. Yet in Katsuie's heart, none of them was dead. They were all watching his every movement, all speaking to him. Katsuie gently stroked Oichi's cold cheek, clenched his teeth, and walked out onto the gallery.

units.source_en: By then, apart from Katsuie, only some thirty bodies remained in the keep.
units.source_zh: 此时，天守阁上除了胜家，只余三十多具尸身了。

units.source_en: Yet in Katsuie's heart, none of them was dead. They were all watching his every movement, all speaking to him.
units.source_zh: 然而，在胜家心中，他们都没有死，都在凝视着自己的一举一动，都在和自己说话。

units.source_en: Katsuie gently stroked Oichi's cold cheek, clenched his teeth, and walked out onto the gallery.
units.source_zh: 胜家轻轻地抚过阿市冰冷的面颊，紧咬着牙关走到了回廊。

paragraphs.source_zh: 此时，天守阁上除了胜家，只余三十多具尸身了。然而，在胜家心中，他们都没有死，都在凝视着自己的一举一动，都在和自己说话。胜家轻轻地抚过阿市冰冷的面颊，紧咬着牙关走到了回廊。

paragraphs.source_en: The remaining attendants had all fallen back to the fourth and fifth floors. To keep the enemy from drawing near and win Katsuie his final moments, every one of them was fighting to the death.

units.source_en: The remaining attendants had all fallen back to the fourth and fifth floors. To keep the enemy from drawing near and win Katsuie his final moments, every one of them was fighting to the death.
units.source_zh: 剩下的近侍们都已退到了四层、五层，为了不让敌人近前，为了给胜家赢得最后的时间，所有的人都在殊死拼杀。

paragraphs.source_zh: 剩下的近侍们都已退到了四层、五层，为了不让敌人近前，为了给胜家赢得最后的时间，所有的人都在殊死拼杀。

paragraphs.source_en: Suddenly, a great column of flame surged skyward from the fourth floor.

units.source_en: Suddenly, a great column of flame surged skyward from the fourth floor.
units.source_zh: 突然，一股冲天的大火从四层升起。

paragraphs.source_zh: 突然，一股冲天的大火从四层升起。

paragraphs.source_en: “Soldiers of Hashiba Hideyoshi, hear me—” Katsuie's figure appeared above the billowing smoke. As one, the soldiers storming the keep shaded their eyes with their hands and looked up.

units.source_en: “Soldiers of Hashiba Hideyoshi, hear me—” Katsuie's figure appeared above the billowing smoke.
units.source_zh: “羽柴秀吉的士兵们，你们听着——”胜家的身影出现在了滚滚浓烟之上。

units.source_en: As one, the soldiers storming the keep shaded their eyes with their hands and looked up.
units.source_zh: 进攻天守阁的士兵不约而同地手搭凉棚往上观看。

paragraphs.source_zh: “羽柴秀吉的士兵们，你们听着——”胜家的身影出现在了滚滚浓烟之上。进攻天守阁的士兵不约而同地手搭凉棚往上观看。

paragraphs.source_en: “All of you, watch closely. See how the hero Oni Shibata performs seppuku...”

units.source_en: “All of you, watch closely. See how the hero Oni Shibata performs seppuku...”
units.source_zh: “你们都给我好好地看着，看一看英雄鬼柴田是如何切腹的……”

paragraphs.source_zh: “你们都给我好好地看着，看一看英雄鬼柴田是如何切腹的……”

units.source_en: An uproar instantly erupted below.

ja.t: ではたちまちどよめきが

units.source_zh: 下面顿时一片哗然。

paragraphs.source_en: Katsuie planted one foot on the railing. Though thousands of eyes below were watching his every move, he felt that only Oichi behind him was gazing at him with ardent expectation. I, Katsuie, will never bring shame upon you! Oichi, watch closely. Behold the tragic, valiant final moment of an old warrior...

units.source_en: Katsuie planted one foot on the railing. Though thousands of eyes below were watching his every move, he felt that only Oichi behind him was gazing at him with ardent expectation.
units.source_zh: 胜家一只脚踩在栏杆上，虽然此时下面有几千双眼睛在注视着他的一举一动，然而他觉得，只有身后的阿市在热切地望着他。

units.source_en: I, Katsuie, will never bring shame upon you!
units.source_zh: 我胜家决不会给你丢脸！

units.source_en: Oichi, watch closely. Behold the tragic, valiant final moment of an old warrior...
units.source_zh: 阿市，你好好看着，看一个老武士悲壮的最后一刻……

paragraphs.source_zh: 胜家一只脚踩在栏杆上，虽然此时下面有几千双眼睛在注视着他的一举一动，然而他觉得，只有身后的阿市在热切地望着他。我胜家决不会给你丢脸！阿市，你好好看着，看一个老武士悲壮的最后一刻……

paragraphs.source_en: At that very instant, one thunderous explosion followed another, shaking the earth itself, and the nine-story keep came crashing down amid the billowing smoke...

units.source_en: At that very instant, one thunderous explosion followed another, shaking the earth itself, and the nine-story keep came crashing down amid the billowing smoke...
units.source_zh: 就在这一瞬间，隆隆的爆炸声一阵接着一阵，把大地都震得摇晃起来，九重的天守阁轰然倒塌在滚滚浓烟之中……

paragraphs.source_zh: 就在这一瞬间，隆隆的爆炸声一阵接着一阵，把大地都震得摇晃起来，九重的天守阁轰然倒塌在滚滚浓烟之中……
